sections.title: Costa Rica Sustainability, Culture & Wellness Journey
sections.subtitle: A 9-Day Adult Wellness Journey Through Volcanoes, Rainforests and the Pacific Coast
sections.html:
Reconnect with yourself—and with the natural world—on an immersive wellness journey through some of Costa Rica’s most beautiful landscapes. Created especially for adult groups, this thoughtfully paced program blends restorative experiences with gentle outdoor activity, cultural discovery, sustainable living and meaningful connection.

From volcanic hot springs and rainforest trails to farm-fresh meals and quiet mornings beside the Pacific, each day offers a different expression of wellness. Guests will encounter Costa Rica’s extraordinary biodiversity, learn from local farmers and conservationists, experience the country’s welcoming culture and enjoy plenty of space to slow down. It is an enriching journey for travelers who want to return home feeling refreshed, inspired and more connected than when they arrived.

sections.title: Day 1: Arrive, Exhale and Settle In
sections.html:
Welcome to Costa Rica, a country celebrated for its extraordinary natural beauty, peaceful spirit and pura vida approach to life. Upon arrival in San José, meet your local representative and enjoy a private guided transfer to Heredia, a lush province known for its gardens, coffee-growing heritage and refreshing mountain climate.

Settle into Hotel Bougainvillea, a peaceful retreat surrounded by acres of beautifully maintained tropical gardens. The relaxed setting offers a gentle introduction to Costa Rica, with colorful flowers, native trees and abundant birdlife creating an immediate sense of escape.

Take the afternoon to unpack, stroll through the gardens or simply rest after your journey. In the evening, gather for a welcome dinner and meet the guide who will accompany the group through the experiences ahead. This first shared meal offers an opportunity to connect with fellow travelers and ease into a week centered on nature, nourishment and intentional living.

Bougainvillea Hotel

Experience the charm of Bougainvillea Hotel, located in the picturesque Heredia Province, where stunning gardens and breathtaking views await. Enjoy authentic Costa Rican cuisine at the on-site restaurant and unwind by the outdoor swimming pool. With easy access to nearby attractions and an art gallery featuring local artists, this hotel is a delightful retreat for any traveler.

sections.title: Day 2: Volcanoes, Artisans and Thermal Beginnings
sections.subtitle: Heredia–Poás Volcano–Sarchí–Arenal
sections.html:
After breakfast, travel into Costa Rica’s mountainous interior to visit Poás Volcano National Park. Poás is home to one of the world’s largest active volcanic craters, creating a dramatic landscape of misty forest, rugged terrain and fascinating geological formations. Weather and volcanic conditions permitting, enjoy a guided walk and learn how volcanic activity has shaped Costa Rica’s land, ecosystems and agricultural traditions.

Continue to Sarchí, widely considered the center of Costa Rican craftsmanship. The town is especially famous for its brightly painted wooden oxcarts, once used to transport coffee from mountain plantations to market. Discover the symbolism behind their intricate patterns and meet the artistic traditions that continue to define this welcoming community.

Following a locally inspired lunch, continue toward the Arenal region, where the distinctive silhouette of Arenal Volcano rises above forests, farms and natural hot springs. Settle into Volcano Lodge and begin the restorative portion of the journey with time to enjoy the property’s tropical surroundings and volcanically heated thermal waters. The warmth of the pools provides a soothing end to the day and a wonderful opportunity to release the tension of travel.

Volcano Lodge & Hot Springs

Experience the beauty of Costa Rica at Volcano Lodge & Hot Springs, where stunning views of Arenal Volcano await. Enjoy relaxing in the on-site thermal hot springs, surrounded by charming bungalows and lush gardens. With local wildlife just steps away and eco-friendly practices, your stay will be both refreshing and sustainable.

sections.title: Day 3: Nourished by the Land
sections.html:
After breakfast, immerse yourself in the authentic Costa Rican countryside at Arenal Vida Campesina.

Discover traditional farming practices and learn about coffee, cacao, sugar cane and medicinal plants.

A hands-on cooking experience and fresh local lunch provide an opportunity to connect with Costa Rican food culture in a meaningful and sustainable way.

In the afternoon, explore the lush rainforest on a guided walk through the Hanging Bridges.

Take your time to appreciate the sounds, colors and biodiversity of the forest while enjoying gentle physical activity surrounded by nature.

As the day comes to an end, unwind at Ecotermales Hot Springs. Soak in naturally heated volcanic waters surrounded by tropical vegetation, allowing your body and mind to slow down and relax.

Enjoy dinner in this peaceful setting.

All meals included

sections.title: Day 4: Wellness Through Purpose and Movement
sections.html:
This morning offers an opportunity to experience another important dimension of wellness: contributing to something larger than ourselves. Visit the Proyecto Asis Wildlife Rescue Center to learn about the rehabilitation and protection of Costa Rica’s native wildlife. Through a guided educational and volunteer experience, discover the challenges facing wild animals and the responsible steps being taken to return eligible animals to their natural habitats.

The experience combines observation, education and purposeful participation without encouraging harmful interaction with wildlife. Pause for a Costa Rican coffee break before continuing with the day.

After lunch, explore the trails of Arenal 1968, named for the historic eruption that dramatically transformed the surrounding landscape. Walk across volcanic terrain and through regenerating forest while learning how nature has reclaimed the land over time. On a clear day, the trail offers impressive views of Arenal Volcano and Lake Arenal. The walk provides moderate, mindful movement in a landscape that powerfully illustrates resilience, transformation and renewal.

Return to the hotel to rest before enjoying dinner at a local restaurant.

sections.title: Day 5: Into Costa Rica’s Wild Heart
sections.html:
After breakfast, travel north to Caño Negro, one of Costa Rica’s most important wetland ecosystems. Far removed from the country’s busier visitor areas, this protected region is known for its peaceful waterways, seasonal lagoons and remarkable concentration of wildlife.

Enjoy a guided boat journey through the wetlands, allowing the landscape to unfold at a slow and unhurried pace. Depending on the season and conditions, guests may see monkeys, caimans, iguanas, sloths and an impressive variety of resident and migratory birds. With the boat gliding gently through the water, the experience offers both extraordinary wildlife viewing and the meditative calm of being surrounded by nature.

After lunch, continue to Rancho Margot, an off-the-grid ecological ranch and lodge near Lake Arenal. The property has been designed around sustainability, responsible agriculture and living in balance with the surrounding environment.

Once darkness falls, join a naturalist for a guided night walk. The rainforest takes on an entirely different personality after sunset, when frogs, insects and other nocturnal creatures become active. Listen closely, move quietly and discover a world that remains hidden during the day.

Conclude the evening with dinner at the lodge, accompanied by the sounds of the forest.

Rancho Margot

Experience the tranquility of Rancho Margot, where eco-friendly practices meet breathtaking scenery. Set against the backdrop of Lake Nicaragua, this unique retreat offers organic farm-fresh meals and accommodations crafted from natural materials. Enjoy outdoor adventures like hiking and horseback riding while connecting with the area's rich wildlife.

sections.title: Day 6: The Art of Living Slowly
sections.html:
Today is intentionally unhurried, inviting guests to step away from schedules and experience a slower, more mindful rhythm of life.

Take a guided tour of Rancho Margot and learn how the property brings together regenerative agriculture, renewable energy, responsible tourism and farm-to-table dining. Discover how food is grown, resources are reused and waste is thoughtfully reduced. More than a traditional farm tour, the experience encourages reflection on the relationship between personal wellness, community wellbeing and the health of the environment.

The remainder of the day offers space to simply be. Spend time walking through the grounds, resting beside the river, observing the surrounding forest or joining any available lodge activities. Without the distractions of everyday life, guests can reconnect with their surroundings and with one another.

Fresh, locally sourced meals are enjoyed at the lodge throughout the day, reinforcing the ranch’s philosophy that wellness begins with respect for the land and the food it provides.

sections.title: Day 7: From Green Forests to Blue Horizons
sections.html:
After breakfast, leave the rainforest behind and journey toward Guanacaste, a sun-drenched region known for its ranching traditions, dry tropical forests and beautiful Pacific coastline.

Along the way, stop at El Viejo Wetlands for an experience that brings together nature, history and Costa Rican hospitality. Explore the surrounding environment while learning about the culture and traditions of Guanacaste. A traditional lunch introduces the group to regional flavors and recipes shaped by the area’s agricultural heritage.

Continue to Bahía del Sol, a beachfront boutique hotel located along the warm waters of the Pacific. Upon arrival, settle into the coastal surroundings and enjoy time to unwind. Walk barefoot along the beach, rest beneath the palms or watch the changing light over the ocean.

This transition from Costa Rica’s lush interior to its open coastline marks the beginning of the journey’s final chapter—a time devoted to rest, spaciousness and reconnection.

Bahia del Sol Beach Front Boutique Hotel

Experience the Bahia del Sol Beach Front Boutique Hotel, where you can enjoy direct access to beautiful beaches and indulge in luxurious amenities, including a rejuvenating spa. This unique hotel features architecture that harmonizes with its surroundings, offering personalized service to ensure a tranquil retreat. Discover vibrant local attractions just moments away.

sections.title: Day 8: A Day to Simply Be
sections.html:
After a week of discovery, movement and meaningful experiences, today is yours to enjoy without a set agenda. Wake slowly, savor a leisurely breakfast and decide what restoration looks like for you.

Swim in the warm Pacific, relax beside the pool, take a peaceful walk along the shoreline or find a shaded place to read and reflect. Guests may choose quiet personal time or enjoy the company of fellow travelers in an easygoing beachfront setting. The absence of a formal schedule is intentional, allowing everyone to listen to their own needs and fully absorb the experiences of the journey.

In the evening, gather for a special farewell dinner. Celebrate the friendships formed, lessons learned and memorable moments shared across Costa Rica. As the sun sets over the Pacific, reflect on the many forms wellness has taken throughout the trip: nourishing food, purposeful movement, thermal relaxation, human connection and time immersed in the natural world.

sections.title: Day 9: Carrying Pura Vida Home
sections.html:
Enjoy a final breakfast at the hotel and, time permitting, one last look at the Pacific before beginning the journey home.

Depart Costa Rica feeling renewed by its landscapes, inspired by its commitment to sustainability and enriched by the warmth of its people. The journey may be ending, but the spirit of pura vida—living with gratitude, presence and appreciation for life’s simple pleasures—is something each traveler can carry home.
